triples.rationale: Obadiah describes Esau searched out and his hidden things seized. Jeremiah likewise names Esau, then says their secrets are uncovered and they cannot hide, preserving that passage's change to plural pronouns.
triples.source_text: How Esau has been searched out, and his hidden things seized!

target_units.text: For I dragged Esau away and uncovered their secrets; they certainly cannot hide. They perished by the hand of his brother and his neighbor, and it is not possible
